overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a highly targeted professional academic presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, accumulating 3,580 followers. Engagement is strong across all channels, driven primarily by announcements of research publications, open positions, software tools, and grant awards.

contentThemes.description: Posts focused on research publications, conferences, and methodologies regarding information operations and online coordination.
Updates on open-source research tools like CooRnet v2.0 for detecting coordinated link sharing.
Recruitment posts for Postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Major career and lab achievements, including newly awarded research grants.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research breakthroughs and tool releases with visual assets (e.g., charts, screenshots, infographics) to further boost engagement.
Increase publishing frequency on Mastodon and LinkedIn to match the engagement levels seen on Bluesky.
Leverage open-ended questions in posts to drive comment interactions on text-heavy networks like Bluesky and Mastodon.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest average engagement rate (6.14%) with strong repost activity, showing high community interest in academic paper announcements and PhD opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche academic community engaged with methodological discussions and tool releases, generating steady support relative to follower base.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest follower base yielding the highest absolute engagement numbers (likes and comments), particularly around major career achievements and recruitment.

topPerformingContent.content: Just published our new paper on coordinated inauthentic behavior on social media platforms!
